agent.result_text:
The latest full `bin/e2e` run passed all 4 tests: "watched total" and scenarios 1–3.

The first run had one failure in scenario 1: an edit to the amount of a claim on Cam's row was refused at `e2e/specs/acceptance.spec.ts:173`. That scenario then passed in two runs on its own and again in the full run. My change doesn't touch claim editing, so it looks like an intermittent timing issue in the existing claim editor, but I didn't find the cause and it may come back.

I've cancelled the reminder I set to check the test run, since it's done.
